title: Another attempt
author: Right-Statement367
selftext:
I was sick of that zombie fb add game and decided to make something on my cellphone. I just used Claude ai to post it on itch. Don’t hate too much. More then welcome to give some advices to a beginner guys :) 

https://1seedeadpeople.itch.io/last-bridge
